about: the lychee material card (materials/lychee/card.py): the Leidus photograph's three pieces under its light (materials/lychee/rig_card.json), to compare with ref/lychee/leidus_lychee_fruits_and_seed.jpg; render with objects/lychee/run.py --res 960x540 (16:9: the camera chain develops 1920x1080 and its fractions only; the photo is 3:2) and --no-diffraction (the photo is a focus stack: f/64 here only for its depth of field)

camera.why: the photo's lens (105 mm) at its magnification if the fruit is 30 mm (frame about 84 mm across); about 12 degrees down, by eye; f/64 stands in for the photo's focus stack

expose.why: as the other cards; brightness is compared as ratios between the pieces
